name: In-Context Teacher–Student Guidance for Open-Weight Browser Agents
notes: The annotation was reviewed against the publisher PDF and the Crossref deposit for its DOI. The method, In-Context Learning Guidance (ICLG), has GPT-5.1 solve tasks offline and appends its reasoning fields alone to the student prompt; the teacher's low-level actions stay outside that prompt, and teacher calls precede the student run. Evaluation serves the 130 MiniWoB++ tasks locally, caps each run at 5 minutes and 25 interaction steps, counts a score of at least 0.5 as solved, and reports single runs: seven of ten students improve and three lose one task. Retry and refined-prompt ablations cover three students. The paper names no code release or arXiv version.
summary: Training-free protocol that turns a teacher model's offline reasoning traces into prompt guidance for open-weight browser agents; on MiniWoB++ it lifts solved student-task pairs from 208 to 271 across ten students.
